resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because more than one candidate came back anomalous, meaning some biometric modalities matched the applicant while others did not, with no face match and no confirmed true duplicate among them. The applicant was not whitelisted, so the unresolved matches could not be waived.
resolution.synthesis: The resident applied for a fresh enrolment, which requires their biometrics to be globally unique. Manual de-duplication could neither confirm nor clear several partial biometric matches, so uniqueness was never established and the packet was rejected while the matched records holding an Aadhaar were suspended. A fresh packet with a clean, high-quality capture of all modalities is needed to settle those matches.
